items.basis: Auto-enrolment employer minimum 3% of qualifying earnings; band £6,240–£50,270, trigger £10,000 (held for 2026/27)

items.basis: Apprenticeship Levy 0.5% of paybill above £3m (£15,000 allowance) — HMRC

items.basis: IDR Standby, call-out and shift pay 2025 study (60+ organisations, mostly manufacturing): two-shift systems ~17–19% → 18% midpoint. IDR 2023: double-day mean 17%, median 18%.
items.notes: Applied to all shop-floor roles (both shifts of a double-day pattern are paid it); not to the process engineer (day work). Make UK Shift Patterns, Pay Premia and Benefits 2026 exists but rates are paywalled (https://www.makeuk.org/insights/reports/shift-patterns-pay-premia-and-benefits-2026).

items.basis: Statutory 5.6 weeks (28 days for a 5-day week, may include bank holidays) — Working Time Regulations
items.notes: Not re-read this session (gov.uk unreachable); statutory minimum, standing law. Many engineering employers give 25 + 8 BH = 33 days — that would cut productive hours by a further ~39 h (2.2%).

items.basis: ONS Sickness absence in the UK labour market 2025: 2.0% of working hours lost (4.4 days/worker); process, plant & machine operatives among the highest-rate occupations (figure not given).
items.notes: Treated as paid (company sick pay) and non-productive — i.e. it reduces productive hours, not gross pay. Operative absence is likely above 2.0%.

notes: Access: ons.gov.uk, gov.uk, nomisweb and recruiter sites were blocked from this session (curl 403 / WebFetch DNS failure); all figures come from web-search snippets of the named pages. ASHE Table 14 figures come via huntukvisasponsors.com, which cites "ONS ASHE 2025 provisional, Table 14" — verify against the ONS xlsx before merging.
ASHE figures are UK national full-time medians, not West Midlands / North-East / North-West; regional tables (ASHE Table 15) were not reachable.
Hourly = ASHE weekly basic ÷ assumed weekly hours (39 shop floor, 37.5 engineer). ASHE hourly-excl-overtime columns would be better; not reachable.
Loaded multiplier on Oct-2026 basic: ~1.60 for 2-shift shop floor (18% shift + 15% NIC + 5% pension + 0.5% levy, ÷ 87.4% productive), ~1.36 for a day-work engineer.

Not found: SOC 5221 / 5211 / 5212 / 5250 / 3115 ASHE 2025 medians; DESNZ table 3.4.1/3.4.2 medium & large band prices; employer liability insurance; PPE/training per head; Make UK 2026 shift-premium figures (paywalled).
